review_scope: Typed component definitions and bounded Pi_D,C preservation route

findings.finding: The conjunction has an explicit typed route and separates type, witness, relation, trace, and history conditions.
The component definitions are not circular at the syntactic level, but Relation_C depends on the semantics of TypedWitness_C and the declared witness provenance.
HistoryPresent_C tests presence and context, not sufficiency or causal content of history.
project_w and Pi_D,C are represented as fixture booleans and labels; no executable projection mapping constructs projected witnesses.
The finite checker supports classification consistency but does not prove preservation for arbitrary source values or contexts.
Nonempty residue is correctly excluded as a preservation input, avoiding collapse conflation.
